assumptions.text: A leak-site post naming a victim means the group attacked that victim.

test.rule: Claims matched to the victim's own filing (VG-IND-2); identity reviews in the migration headers

assumptions.note: Operation Cronos: 23 'victims' on the seized LockBit site were NCA and FBI notices (migration 095). Groups also re-post old victims and inflate lists. Every claim is published as claimed, never as fact.

assumptions.text: One brand name is one operation.

test.rule: Identity, lineage and shared tooling kept apart; alias merges are queued as findings (README)

assumptions.note: LockBit existed as seven records before migration 095; public alias lists file distinct groups together.

assumptions.text: Claims appear on leak sites soon after the attack.

test.rule: Compare discovered_date with the victim's disclosed incident_date where matched

assumptions.text: A current EPSS score is a fair estimate of exploitation activity in the next 30 days.

test.rule: FIRST's published EPSS performance; Vigil's own alerts scored later by Verdict

assumptions.text: A feed that stops is noticed.

test.rule: feed_expectations rows and the feed-health workflow; a feed without a row is not watched

assumptions.note: Holds only for registered feeds (CLAUDE.md: a feed without a feed_expectations row can stop silently).
